events.title: Plans for a merger between West London rivals 풀럼 and 퀸스 파크 레인저스 are scrapped after the Football League vetoed the proposal. Former 아스널 winger 리엄 브레이디 returns to England in a £150,000 move to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 from Ascoli of Italy. The Football League Cup semi-final tie between 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 아스널 goes to a replay after 아스널 win 2–1 at White Hart Lane , following a 1–0 defeat at Highbury in the first leg.
England winger John Barnes is put on the transfer list by 왓퍼드. 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are among the teams expected to make a bid for the 23-year-old, who first signed for 왓퍼드 in 1981.

아스널 reach the League Cup Final after a 2–1 replay victory over 토트넘 홋스퍼. In the league, 애스턴 빌라 miss the chance to climb out of the bottom four after 윔블던 hold them to a goalless draw at Villa Park. A clash between the top two clubs in the Second Division at the Baseball Ground sees 더비 카운티 draw 0–0 with 포츠머스.
에버턴 sign striker Wayne Clarke from 버밍엄 시티 for £300,000. Oldham go second in the Second Division with a 4–0 home win over Reading.

찰턴 애슬레틱 boost their First Division survival hopes and climb out of the bottom four with a 2–1 home win over London rivals 웨스트햄 유나이티드, who drop to 14th. 첼시 continue their climb to mid-table security with a 1–0 home win over 아스널, denting the title hopes of 조지 그레이엄 's side. A relegation crunch match at The Dell sees 사우샘프턴 beat 레스터 시티 4–0. 브라이언 롭슨 scores once and Nicky Reid scores an own goal as 맨체스터 유나이티드 win the Manchester derby 2–0 at Old Trafford . 리버풀 go top of the table with a 2–0 home win over 루턴 타운. 토트넘 홋스퍼 close in on the top three with a 1–0 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 stay bottom of the table but boost their survival hopes with a 2–1 home win over an 애스턴 빌라 side who are now second from bottom.
에버턴 squander the chance to return to the top of the table with a 2–1 defeat at 왓퍼드.
블랙번 로버스 pay 던디 £30,000 for defender Colin Hendry . Leaders 리버풀 beat 아스널 1–0 at Highbury.
옥스퍼드 유나이티드 pay a club record £600,000 for Brighton & Hove Albion striker Dean Saunders in a bid to avoid relegation.

코번트리 시티 progress to the FA Cup semi-finals for the first time in their history thanks to a 3–0 away win over 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the quarter-finals. 아스널's hopes of a domestic treble are ended with a 3–1 defeat at home to 왓퍼드. In the First Division, 리버풀 win 3–1 at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 루턴 타운 climb back up to fourth win a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. A Second Division rampage at Selhurst Park sees 크리스털 팰리스 beat 버밍엄 시티 6–0.

토트넘 홋스퍼 move closer to a record eighth FA Cup triumph as they eliminate 윔블던 2–0 at Plough Lane. 위건 애슬레틱's dreams end with a 2–0 home defeat by 리즈 유나이티드. For the first time in the history of the FA Cup, all four quarter-final ties have been won by the away team.
크리스털 팰리스, chasing promotion in the Second Division, sign midfielder 앨런 파듀 for £7,000 from Conference side 요빌 타운 .
22-year-old striker Paul Stewart leaves Third Division strugglers 블랙풀 to sign for 맨체스터 시티 in a £200,000 deal.

에버턴 keep their title hopes alive with a 2–1 home win over 찰턴 애슬레틱. The latest relegation crunch thriller sees 사우샘프턴 beat 애스턴 빌라 5–0 at The Dell . In the Second Division, 플리머스 아가일 boost their hopes of reaching the First Division for the first time by beating 그림즈비 타운 5–0 at Home Park .

A First Division clash at White Hart Lane adds heat to the title race as 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 리버풀 1–0. 리버풀 are still six points ahead of their nearest rivals 에버턴, who have two games in hand and a superior goal difference, while 토트넘 홋스퍼 are 14 points off the top but have five games in hand.

찰턴 애슬레틱 and 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 share the points in a goalless draw at Selhurst Park and stay clear of the bottom four. 사우샘프턴 move closer to safety with a 3–0 home win over 루턴 타운. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's downturn continues with a 2–0 home defeat to 셰필드 웬즈데이. 윔블던 move closer to securing a top-half finish to their first season in the First Division by beating 코번트리 시티 2–1.

애스턴 빌라 drop two more points in their survival battle as they draw 1–1 at home to 왓퍼드. 레스터 시티 climb out of the bottom four with a 4–1 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain bottom after drawing 1–1 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼.
아스널 pay 레스터 시티 £850,000 for 24-year-old striker Alan Smith , and then loan him back to 레스터 시티 until the end of the season.

리버풀's title bid is hit with a shock 2–1 home defeat against 윔블던. 에버턴 gain a crucial 1–0 victory over 아스널 at Highbury , boosting their title hopes and leaving the home side's title hopes looking slim. 맨체스터 시티 crash to the bottom of the table with a 4–0 defeat against 레스터 시티 at Filbert Street , which is a major boost for the home side's survival hopes. 애스턴 빌라 boost their own survival bid with a 1–0 home win over 코번트리 시티. 루턴 타운 go third with a 3–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 climb off the bottom of the table with a 2–0 home win over 사우샘프턴. 포츠머스 go top of the Second Division with a 3–1 home win over 선덜랜드.
Second Division 블랙번 로버스 lift the Full Members' Cup by beating First Division 찰턴 애슬레틱 1–0 at Wembley with a goal from Colin Hendry in their first Wembley final for 27 years.

리버풀 end March as First Division leaders, but only by a three-point margin over an 에버턴 side who have two games in hand. 아스널's challenge has faded after a run of six League matches without scoring, but 루턴 타운 continue to defy the odds by occupying third place. 맨체스터 시티, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 are tied on points at the bottom of the table. 포츠머스 and 더비 카운티 remain at the top of the Second Division, while 올덤 애슬레틱, 입스위치 타운 and 플리머스 아가일 are still in the play-off zone.
